q: (When the Mushrikeen of Makkah “promised” to Rasulullaah ﷺ that they would accept Islaam only if he worshipped or even kissed their idols, Allaah instructed Rasulullaah ﷺ with the following words:)

v.s: I do not worship what you worship.
v.c: I do not worship what you worship,

q: “...nor do you worship what I worship
v.s: Nor are you worshippers of what I worship.
v.c: nor do you worship what I worship.

q: “I am neither a worshipper of that which you worship
(and shall never be in future either)...”
v.s: Nor will I be a worshipper of what you worship.
v.c: I will never worship what you worship,

q: “...nor are you worshippers of that which I worship.”
v.s: Nor will you be worshippers of what I worship.
v.c: nor will you ever worship what I worship.

v.s: For you is your religion, and for me is my religion."
v.c: You have your way, and I have my Way.”
